propositions: When a Jira workflow forbids the direct end-state transition rebar requests, outbound sync fails and the ticket drifts; replay must walk recorded intermediate status hops to reach the target via allowed transitions.

Recorded status hops are extracted from append-only STATUS.json events sorted by filename, forward-mapped to Jira names, and replayed in order without inverting the non-injective LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA map.
Replay resumes from the current Jira status by anchoring on its last positional match in the hop sequence, then executes only the remaining hops.
Replay aborts on any hop raising RuntimeError (Cloud), ValueError or IllegalTransitionError (DC), or HTTPError, falling through to comment-fallback and drift; no partial hop is retried.
The replay call site is _update_one_scalar_update in dispatch_one.py, which receives local_id from the mutation and resolves the tracker via config.tracker_dir(reconciler_repo_root()).
Falsy or absent local_id skips replay entirely and behaves as today with comment-fallback and drift.
